verdict.rationale: Khoj documents fully local operation: Ollama chat models via its OpenAI-compatible server, offline chat models, on-device embeddings, and use without an internet connection when self-hosted. An earlier hands-on report said chat required an OpenAI key, but later docs and community discussion of local chat (Llama V2/GPT4All experiments) supersede it, so it is not a concrete dispute of current behavior. Only Ollama is explicitly named among the requested backends, and a developer reported small local models were weak for notes context. missing for 10: explicit documentation for llama.cpp, LM Studio and vLLM backends, and independent hands-on confirmation of a fully cloud-free chat setup with good local-model quality.

support.subject: As a privacy-first user, I can run the assistant entirely on local models — Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, or vLLM — with no cloud model dependency

citations.quote: Ollama exposes a local OpenAI API compatible server. This makes it possible to use chat models from Ollama with Khoj.
You can even use Khoj without an internet connection if deployed on your personal computer.
You can generate your embeddings directly on your machine, and then use an offline chat client so that your data never leaves your machine.
Chat with any local or online LLM (e.g llama3, qwen, gemma, mistral, gpt, claude, gemini, deepseek).
Works online or offline: Chat using online or offline AI chat models
